title: 병원에서 보험까지: 진찰, 처방전, 보험료
objective: By the end, you can use ten words about hospital visits, medicine, and health costs, such as 진찰, 처방전, 부작용 and 보험료, in short sentences.
summary: Ten intermediate words for seeing a doctor, taking medicine, and paying for care in Korea.

task.title: Use the medical words
task.line: Read each sentence or situation, then choose, write, or order the words you learned on page 1.

words.meaning: symptom (what you feel when you are sick)
a check-up by a doctor (진찰을 받다: to see a doctor)
words.exampleMeaning: You have to wait about 30 minutes to see the doctor.

words.example: 검사 결과를 보고 장염 진단을 받았어요.
words.exampleMeaning: After seeing the test results, I was diagnosed with an intestinal infection.

words.meaning: prescription (the paper you take to the pharmacy)
words.exampleMeaning: Take your prescription to the pharmacy on the first floor.

words.example: 이 약은 졸음 같은 부작용이 있을 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: This medicine may cause side effects like drowsiness.

words.meaning: to be admitted to (stay in) a hospital
words.exampleMeaning: My grandmother was in the hospital for a week with pneumonia.

words.meaning: surgery, an operation (수술을 받다: to have surgery)
words.example: 수술 전날 밤에는 아무것도 드시면 안 돼요.
words.exampleMeaning: You must not eat or drink anything the night before your surgery.

words.meaning: insurance payment (the money you pay for insurance)
words.exampleMeaning: My health insurance payment comes out of my salary every month.
My dental bill was higher than I expected.

words.meaning: vaccination (예방 접종을 받다: to get vaccinated)
words.example: 독감 예방 접종을 받으러 보건소에 갔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I went to the public health center to get a flu shot.

exercises: Choose the right word: 약을 먹은 뒤에 계속 어지러우면 ____일 수 있으니까 의사에게 말하세요. (부작용 / 처방전)
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 의사 선생님이 써 준 ____을 약국에 냈어요.
Write the word that matches each situation (입원하다 / 예방 접종 / 치료비): ① 다리를 다쳐서 병원에서 며칠 지내야 해요. ② 아기가 병에 걸리지 않게 미리 주사를 맞아요. ③ 병원에서 치료를 받고 낸 돈이에요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list (write the word only): 기침이 나고 열이 나는 ____이 사흘째 계속돼요.
Choose the right word: 이번 달부터 건강 ____가 조금 올랐어요. (보험료 / 치료비)
Put the events in the order they usually happen: (A) 맹장염 진단을 받았어요. (B) 수술을 받았어요. (C) 배가 아파서 진찰을 받았어요.
answers: ① 입원하다 ② 예방 접종 ③ 치료비
